_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. The release assets of Sangam 0.1.0 (M-147, CR-03): one CycloneDX SBOM, one notices bundle and the licence gate for each. excluded_from_jar: a dependency the spring-boot-maven-plugin keeps out of the fat jar (it ships in lib-ext); boot_tooling: launcher jars the plugin adds to BOOT-INF/lib that are not dependencies (sbom_matches_jar.py); sbom_from + select: the distribution's SBOM is the named module's SBOM reduced to the components whose purl starts with a select entry (lib-ext). Ids are used by check_licences.py --distribution (allowed_in scopes), sbom_matches_jar.py, notice_bundle.py and register_check.py. {version} is the release version. A distribution marked pending has no build yet; the release fails while a required distribution is missing (never PASS when skipped, CR-01).

distributions._note: the simulators-app profile that builds this jar is not in sangam-integration/pom.xml (W4-C REQUEST to the integrator); until it exists the release fails here

module sangam-pdf-validator (W4-D, decisions 114, 119); the only distribution where the Rhino and veraPDF scoped entries apply. Shipped as the validator jar plus its runtime class path (lib/), as pdf-validator.Dockerfile builds it; the lib directory is matched against the module SBOM

decision 232: the opt-in NATS add-on of the server (lib-ext, off by default; server.Dockerfile WITH_NATS=true). Exactly jnats and its Bouncy Castle jar bcprov-lts8on, as resolved for sangam-integration (jnats optional there) and staged by deploy/docker/server/nats-addon.sh; the SBOM is the sangam-integration SBOM reduced to those two, so any other jar in lib/ fails the match (fail closed). Not combinable with the esign add-on (two Bouncy Castle providers)

decision 217: the opt-in eSign and DSC add-on of the server (lib-ext, off by default; server.Dockerfile WITH_ESIGN=true). Shipped as the sangam-esign jar plus lib/, the runtime jars the server fat jar does not ship (deploy/docker/server/esign-addon.sh); the SBOM is the module SBOM reduced to Bouncy Castle, so any other jar in lib/ fails the match (fail closed)

decisions 128 and 157; the build args (nsjail and kafel commits, the Ubuntu snapshot id) are pinned in build_args; the release is BLOCKED while any is empty; the resolved Ubuntu package versions (/licenses/OS-PACKAGES.txt) are recorded next to the SBOM (decision 118)

M-103 (W4-D; decisions 118, 157, 167): optional OCR sidecar, Tesseract as a program from the pinned Ubuntu snapshot (tesseract-ocr, tesseract-ocr-eng, tesseract-ocr-hin and their dependencies, each with its copyright file under /licenses/sangam-ocr/os-packages); the release is BLOCKED while UBUNTU_SNAPSHOT is empty; /licenses/OS-PACKAGES.txt is recorded next to the SBOM
M-090 (W4-I): shaded jar, Jackson inside; its register rows come from the E16 inventory

_comment_not_released: Not release assets in 0.1.0: tools/sangam-cli (built, not released; CONFLICTS-AND-OBLIGATIONS section 2), Sangam.Sdk.Hosting (decision 132, source only), the FastAPI adapter (decision 131, deferred).
